briefings.title: Anthropic Hits $2 Trillion in Historic IPO | Altimeter's Four Seasons of AI
briefings.tldr: Altimeter AI Partner Apoorv Agrawal breaks down the historic scale of the AI supercycle—where Big Tech CapEx has hit $860 billion—and explains why Anthropic’s S-1 reveals one of the most capital-efficient, fastest-scaling businesses in history, underpinned by a 1.5T–2T IPO valuation (11–14x forward revenue) and a "Four Seasons of AI" framework led by Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceX, and Google.
